Trajectory scoring rubric

how the quality score on this board is computed

Trajectory Quality Score rule-based, no LLM judge

CompositeTQS = Σ w·s over the weighted dimensions below (Σw = 1.00); each s is a rule score in [0, 1].Weighted dimensions
SUB— submission completeness: whether the run delivered a complete patch0.33
STP— step efficiency: reaching the same result in fewer steps scores higher0.27
TVR— test verification: whether the run wrote and ran tests to check its own fix0.23
FEC— file-edit concentration: edits focused on few files rather than scattered (raised to the 5th power before weighting)0.10
DPI— dirty-pattern penalty: truncation, edits never committed, loops, repeated errors (cubed before weighting)0.07
Diagnostic dimensions
Carried for inspection at weight 0, so they never move the score: oec, iac, ped, psn, tte, scp.
Scores come from the exported SFT quality facts (swe_data_process rule_score); a trajectory with no facts is counted as unscored, never as zero.
